policy.completion: required files changed and host argv checks passed only for tasks with configured host verification; repository-only selection remains not_configured
policy.identity: same assignment, prepared repository, native session, provider/model and permission envelope
policy.native_thread_title: canonical task title via optional thread/name/set after turn/start; unsupported naming is warning only
policy.openclaw_catalog: pinned native models list --json; 2 seconds and 64 KiB bound; native --model for selection
policy.heartbeat_ownership: retain supervisor-owned execution IDs through verification/correction/terminal acknowledgement independently of native slot count
policy.daemon_update_activity: IPC counts supervisor-owned verification and pending results alongside native sessions without double counting

execution_environment_status.local_configuration: host-only IPC stores exact workspace/task repository and host verification bindings atomically; changes affect subsequent executions only
execution_environment_status.local_visibility: actual prepared execution directories remain in local IPC observations; no directory or command is exported as shared execution context
execution_environment_status.run_binding: capture the host binding before workspace preparation; native session scope pins that immutable selection
execution_environment_status.diagnostics: bounded workspace kind, verification status, failure code, and next action; legacy absence is unknown rather than verified
execution_environment_status.automatic_reexecution: RIID-5822/5823 adds typed known-not-started recovery only; no dispatched/unknown outcome replay. See docs/30-architecture/provider-recovery.md.
execution_environment_status.repository_only: A repository-only binding runs without host verification; changed_files and checks must both be empty or both configured. Its instructions must not claim required host checks when none were configured.
execution_environment_status.windows_ipc: Each accepted connection owns a fresh pipe handle. Closing preserves buffered response for a delayed client read; do not force-disconnect or block on flushing an unread response.

verification.native_correction: Codex two-turn native resume, instruction marker, same clone, real file change and host check passed
limits: OpenClaw worktree scheduling capability remains conservative
pre-dispatch recovery is separately fixture-verified; no CLI updates or dispatched-outcome replay
unbound tasks do not have host semantic verification

promote_after: external-effect idempotency and terminal delivery convergence

loop.observation: Planning-only results, repeated setup prompts and discarded instructions can leave assigned work undone.
loop.hypothesis: Native instruction delivery and bounded host-evidence feedback improve actual execution without blind replay.
loop.execute: Run deterministic identity/limit/cancellation tests and separate opt-in native file-write/instruction gates.
loop.evaluate: Reject missing evidence, unsafe recovery and unbounded correction; preserve provider-native failure reasons.
loop.retrospective: Selected local provider gates pass; provider-outage recovery remains an explicit open intake loop.
